messages:
anna: Quick proposal — move to a "metadata-only" production logging default for requests/responses. We keep provenance (route, model, latency, tokens, route-id, correlation-id) but strip payload text by default. aim: useful telemetry + minimal PII risk.
mo: define metadata-only? what fields are considered "payload" vs "metadata" here?
devon: metadata-only = headers + routing + timing + model-version + token counts + embeddings dims. no prompt/completion strings, no user_ids in the body. we still need request hashes for replay-debugging.
sara: embeddings/semantic features worry me — some customers send PHI in embeddings. we should add a per-tenant allowlist flag for inspect-mode.
ops-oncall: request — will this block our oncall debugging? we rely on short sample dumps for incidents.
jamie: propose an "inspect-mode" toggle per-route with TTL and audit logs. default off for prod. UI should show how many records are retained.
devon: rollouts: canary 5% routes for 48h, then 25% for 72h, auto-fallback on error spike or customer opt-out. infra-bot: canary deploy started for branch metadata-logging-proto @ 2026-03-20T15:02:00Z :rocket:
anna: policy details: 
```
logging:
  default: metadata_only
  inspect_mode:
    enabled: false
    ttl_hours: 72
    audit_log: true
  debug_sample_rate: 0.001  # 0.1% full payload capture
  per_tenant_override: true
  hash_strategy: sha256_salt
  pii_redact: auto
```
mo: how does pii_redact=auto work? regex heuristics + fasthash? risk of false negatives.
sara: auto = heuristic scrubbing (emails/ssn/creditcard) + optional cust-managed rules. we should encourage tenant-level opt-in for stronger scrubbing (hmac/pseudonymize).
devon: metrics impact: cohort-based QA needs occasional full payload. suggest a "safe-sample" workflow — expire samples after 7d and keep only tokenized diffs.
jamie: console UX: in route settings show: current logging mode, sample rate, inspect TTL, last inspect access, who accessed. add a banner if tenant has high PII risk.
ops-oncall: also need an emergency breakglass that allows short-term full capture for an incident (audited + email to security).
anna: decision points before EOD Fri: 1) default = metadata_only? 2) debug_sample_rate baseline? 3) inspect-mode TTL and canary plan. volunteers to draft RFC?
mo: +1 metadata_only default. propose baseline debug_sample_rate 0.0005 (0.05%).
sara: +1 but opt-in template for regulated tenants (gov/health) to require per-route explicit allowlist.
devon: I'll draft RFC and config spec. will open PR referencing this thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/XXXX
jamie: i'll mock console bits — need API hooks for "inspectAudit" endpoint.
ops-oncall: tagging retention/incident response folks. oncall: i'll test breakglass flow in staging tomorrow.
anna: ok. next sync on Monday 11am. thanks all :thumbsup:
